regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant trend-eligible leader (scorable via ZEB.TO), with broad participation (breadth 1.0) and high durability (0.75), but crowded. The absolute-trend gate has a validated risk-control edge in this market. Rotation is broad but not directional; no confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the strongest trend-eligible theme with broad participation and healthy durability. The absolute-trend gate supports staying with the trend, though crowding urges size discipline, not a fade. Overweight conditional on continued eligibility and high breadth; this is a trend-following lean, not a return forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=true: absolute-trend gate validated as drawdown/shake-out control
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.37) and an elevated unscheduled macro surprise share (1.0) raise the risk of a sudden narrative shift—especially if AI/geopolitics themes drive a rotation away from value-heavy banks. A trending-but-extended status could turn into a sharp correction.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its 50-day simple moving average on high volume, or the Big Banks theme loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false).

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is not eligible, has low durability (0.35) and negative momentum score, indicating a broken absolute trend. In a market where the trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns, avoiding ineligible themes is a protective lean—not a predictive fade.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend, but absolute-trend gate deems it ineligible
theses.dissent: Gold miners could rally sharply if geopolitical fears spike (macro narrative includes geopolitics). A safe-haven bid might overpower the trend-gate signal, making avoidance a drag on relative performance.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners theme regains eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to true) and its durability_bar crosses above 0.5 with improved breadth.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
